svg.title: E05: Composable harness foundry collaboration and interaction

text.tspan: Evolution · A² A1/A3 · pipeline role collaboration
Construct and evolve reusable harness components.
Harness behavior is assembled from independently
Components are selected, composed, or replaced.
The built harness is executable and its component
Reusing a component does not silently reuse
1 provide(components) → 2 assemble(components) → 3 submit(candidate) → 4 accept(artifact) → 5 report(reusable) → 6 feedback(failure)
Evidence: 2/41 repositories, 2/36 families; 2 trajectories (1 multi-checkpoint); exact audit: 0 supported, 0 unresolved, 1 rejected.
Variation: Typed processors, foundry DSL, component search, and immutable builders.
Negative control: Separate helper functions without component contracts are insufficient.
